title: Code and analysis records for: Integrative Bioinformatics Analysis of Chromatin-Informed Transcription-Factor Biomarkers in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer: An Independent Replication Study
description: Analysis code, SHA-256-hashed internal analysis plan (5 November 2026) and its amendment, frozen cell-line groups, deviations log, results files, figures and data checksums for an independent replication of Bahl et al. (Nat. Commun. 2026, doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76385-8) using public data only: DepMap 23Q2, Project Score, DEMETER2, PRISM Repurposing 20Q2, GDSC1, and GEO GSE323120, GSE337499 and GSE337500. Raw data are not redistributed.
